prompt: According to the U.S. Census Bureau 2022 data, how many states had more than 25% of their population aged 25 and older holding an advanced degree?
answer: Only **one state-equivalent—Washington, D.C. (38.3%)**—had more than 25% of residents aged 25 and older holding a graduate or professional degree. Strictly speaking, among the **50 states**, the number was **zero**.
